sloka: एवं स राजा तं शापमुपभुज्यारिसूदनः ।प्रतिलेभे पुना राज्यं प्रजाश्चैवान्वपालयत् ।। ७.६५.३७ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ sa rājā taṁ śāpamupabhujyārisūdanaḥ ।pratilebhe punā rājyaṁ prajāścaivānvapālayat ।। 7.65.37 ॥

translations.english: Thus, that king, the destroyer of enemies, having endured the curse, regained his kingdom and indeed protected his subjects.
